title: Seat lesson 5: the commander, in command
status: A seat lesson (docs/TUTORIALS.md): step by step, each order highlighted in the crew menu, the next step only once it is given.
source: sam3d; the orders, the drills they start and the reports that answer them are the crew data's (data/crew/osa_ak_crew.json), with their sources; the R-124's A-1 and the R-123M sets (r124_refs, r124_bmp2, r123m_training; voenizdat_osa_1991 p. 246: the crew chief switches on and tunes the sets at «К бою»); the designation by voice from the PU-12M and its read-back (flak11, rrs_1986; docs/crew/12_COMMUNICATIONS.md §3)
notes: The lesson's scenario starts with the headset off and the A-1 on ВС. The commander's half of the game: the learner gives the orders, the NPC crew carries them out. Orders that can't be carried out yet are greyed in the menu with the reason (the order menu's honest greying). The battery's PU-12M (the scenario's c2 primary) gives the drone to the 21 on the battery net; the learner reads it back from the crew menu (the line after the orders).

steps.title: The commander's seat
lines: You are the vehicle commander (командир боевой машины): seat 0 of the Osa 21, front right, beside the driver.

You command the crew: you bring them to readiness, you decide which target to take and when to fire, and you keep in touch with the battery on the radio. Your crew does the rest, at their seats, on your orders, and tells you what they see and do.
Each step highlights the order to give; only that one works. Read, then press Enter.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: Your headset (шлемофон)
lines: First your шлемофон: put it on and plug its cord into your Р-124 box, the A-1.
Your orders reach the crew on the intercom; without the headset you hear only the cabin and must shout them over the turbine, slower and not always heard.
steps.why: The Osa's crew work in their headsets: the turbine and the fans drown a voice in the cabin (r124_refs; voenizdat_osa_1991).
steps.hint: J: put it on (or point the cross at it, left click).

steps.title: Your panel
lines: In front of you: the hatches switch (the launch circuit stays open with a hatch open) and ПРОХОД ПОД МОСТОМ, which lowers the search antenna to pass under a bridge on the march. The lamps tell you the power, the turret's lock and a fault.
steps.hint: Enter: next.

steps.title: The right radio: the battery net
lines: Beside you on the right: the right R-123M radio set. It keeps the battery net: the battery commander in the PU-12M (call sign 10) gives you, the 21, targets and warnings on it, and you answer him on it.
The small switch at its front is your headset's: it picks which of the two R-123M your A-1 puts you on, the left or this one.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: Your A-1 box: ВС or Р-123
lines: Your A-1 box (Р-124) has three positions: ВЫКЛ, ВС and Р-123. On ВС you hear your crew on the intercom and they hear you; the radio is not in your ears. On Р-123 you hear the R-123M your headset switch picks, and the crew's intercom with it.
It is on ВС now. You will turn it to Р-123 to hear the battery net, and back to ВС to give your crew a target.
steps.why: Every target the battery commander gives the vehicle comes through you: only the A-1 and the A-2 reach a radio (r124_refs).
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: Your orders: the crew menu
lines: You give orders through the crew menu: press O to open it. It lists the orders of the drill; an order the crew can't carry out yet is greyed, with the reason. After the orders comes what you say on the battery net yourself: your readiness report and the read-back of a target. O or Esc closes it.
Open it now (O), look, and close it.
steps.hint: O: the crew menu.

steps.title: Give «К бою!»
lines: O, then «К бою!» (Action stations!). Your A-1 is on ВС: the crew hears you on the intercom.
steps.why: It brings the whole crew to readiness from cold: the driver starts the turbine, the operator switches the equipment on and unlocks the turret, the senior operator brings up the search radar, the deputy commander orients the vehicle.
steps.hint: O: the crew menu, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: Your sets: the headset to the right set
lines: Your own part of «К бою»: the radios. Both R-123M are on and warm, on their presets, as you left them. Put the headset switch to the right set, the one beside you: the battery net.
steps.why: At «К бою» the crew chief switches on and tunes the R-123M sets himself (voenizdat_osa_1991 p. 246).
steps.hint: Point the cross at the switch, left click.

steps.title: A-1 to Р-123: on the battery net
lines: Now turn your A-1 to Р-123: the battery net in your ears, and your crew's intercom with it. Their check-in («Первый готов!» ...) still reaches you.
steps.why: From now on the battery commander can reach you: a designation said while you are on ВС is lost to the vehicle.
steps.hint: Point the cross at the A-1's knob, left click (one position on).

steps.title: The crew at work
lines: Listen to them: «Есть!», «Первый готов!», «Второй готов!», «Третий готов!» (each seat in place on the intercom), «Питание подано!», «АПУ расстопорено!», «Готов СОЦ!». From cold this takes some minutes; the lesson runs time faster.
F1 or Tab: visit their seats and watch them work. F1 back to yours.
steps.wait_text: the search radar to come up («Готов СОЦ!»)

steps.title: The chest switch to ПРД
lines: To talk on the set your headset is on, hold your chest switch at ПРД (send). It hangs on its cord from your A-1.
steps.why: Released at ПРМ the set only receives; at ПРД it transmits your words (r123m_training). The NPC commander keys it as he speaks.
steps.hint: Point the cross at the chest switch on the A-1 box, left click.

steps.title: Report to the post: «21 к бою готов!»
steps.wait_text: your crew ready, the search radar up
lines: Your vehicle is ready: tell the battery commander on the net. O, then your report, after the orders: «21 к бою готов, каналы 2, ракет 6!» (ready for action, its two channels and its missiles).
steps.why: When the crew is ready the crew chief reports to the battery's command post, with his channels and missiles (voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 246-247): the battery commander gives targets only to launchers he knows are ready.
steps.hint: O: the crew menu, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: Release it: ПРМ
lines: Said: let the chest switch go back to ПРМ (receive), so the set hears the post again.
steps.why: A set that transmits hears nothing on its frequency; the post's designation comes next (r123m_training).
steps.hint: Right click on the chest switch.

steps.title: A target
lines: A practice drone is flying at you from the north-west. The battery commander has it on his tube and will give it to you on the battery net; your senior operator searches for it too, and when he finds it he asks it (IFF) and calls it to you.
steps.hint: Enter: next.

steps.title: The battery commander's designation
lines: Listen on the battery net: «21, я 10: цель …» with its azimuth and range from you. The battery commander gives each target to one launcher, by number.
steps.wait_text: the battery commander's designation on the battery net

steps.title: The chest switch to ПРД
lines: Hold the chest switch at ПРД again to answer.
steps.hint: Left click on the chest switch.

steps.title: Read it back: «10, я 21: цель …, понял. Приём.»
lines: At once, on the net: O, then your read-back, the line after the orders: the target's number back to the post (10), with your call sign (21).
steps.why: A command on the net is acknowledged at once by repeating it (rrs_1986): until the battery commander hears his number back he doesn't know you have it, and says it again.
steps.hint: O: the crew menu, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: Release it: ПРМ
lines: Back to ПРМ: the post may call you again.
steps.hint: Right click on the chest switch.

steps.title: Search
lines: Your senior operator searches round the bearing the post gave. Wait for his report on the intercom: «Цель, азимут …, дальность …!», and «Ответа нет!»: not one of ours.

steps.title: A-1 to ВС: to the crew
lines: Now give the target to your crew: first your A-1 back to ВС.
steps.why: The drill: the designation goes to the crew on the intercom, and on ВС nothing you say to them goes out on the battery net (docs/crew/12_COMMUNICATIONS.md §3).
steps.hint: Right click on the A-1's knob: one position back.

steps.title: Give «Цель — взять!»
steps.wait_text: the crew ready, the search radar up («Готов СОЦ!»): an order to take a target now would break off their drills
lines: O, then «Цель номер … — взять!» (Take the target!): the number is the one the battery commander gave you.
steps.why: You decide what to engage. The senior operator puts the tracking radar's azimuth on it, the deputy commander designates it (ЦУ), the operator switches the transmitter on: the radar captures it.
steps.hint: O: the crew menu, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: A-1 back to Р-123
lines: And back on the net: A-1 to Р-123.
steps.why: The battery commander may give you another target, or forbid the launch: you must hear him until the target is down.
steps.hint: Point the cross at the A-1's knob, left click (one position on).

steps.title: The capture
lines: Wait for the operator's «Захват!».

steps.title: Give «Цель осмотреть по ТВ!»
lines: O, then «Цель осмотреть по ТВ!» (Look the target over on the TV!).
steps.why: The radar holds an echo; the TV shows what it is. Decoys and false targets look small where their echo says aircraft.
steps.hint: O: the crew menu, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: What the TV shows
lines: The deputy commander switches the camera on and takes the narrow lens. Go and look at his monitor if you like (Tab), then come back (F1).

steps.title: Give «Приготовиться к пуску!»
lines: O, then «Приготовиться к пуску!» (Prepare to launch!).
steps.why: The deputy commander sets live firing and puts the launch key in.
steps.hint: O: the crew menu, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: Into the zone
lines: Wait for the deputy commander's «Цель в зоне!»: the drone inside the missiles' reach. Until then «Пуск разрешаю!» is greyed in your menu: «Цель не в зоне».
steps.wait_text: the target to come into the firing zone

steps.title: Give «Пуск разрешаю!»
lines: O, then «Пуск разрешаю!» (Launch permitted!).
steps.why: Only you permit a launch. The deputy commander turns the key and presses ПУСК.
steps.hint: O: the crew menu, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: Launch
lines: «Пуск!», «Сход!»: the missile is away. Press F6 to follow it, F1 to come back.

steps.title: Missile away
lines: Wait for the deputy commander's report: «Цель поражена!» or «Промах!». After a miss you can order «Вторая — пуск!» while the drone is still in the zone.
steps.wait_text: the missile to reach the drone

steps.title: In command: done
lines: That is the commander's drill for one target: К бою, your A-1 on the battery net, the target given by the battery commander and read back, passed to your crew on ВС and taken, looked at on the TV, the missiles prepared, and the launch permitted in the zone.
Practise it without the highlights: the Missions group's «Osa: crew practice, one target» in the commander's seat; then the battery fight, and the ranges and battles.
Esc: the menu.
